caption: The drawing depicts a single wooden chair with a rich brown tone, featuring intricate carvings. The backrest of the chair has a symmetrical, openwork design with curved and scrolling elements and a central carved motif at the top. The seat is upholstered in a light beige or cream-colored fabric with a subtle, possibly floral, pattern. The front legs of the chair are cabriole-shaped, adorned with shell-like carvings at the knees and terminating in ball-and-claw feet. The seat rail and knees are decorated with additional carved detailing. The background is plain, with no other objects or decorations, and the artist's name "Bernard Krieger" is written in small letters at the bottom left corner of the page. The drawing uses delicate shading to give the chair a three-dimensional appearance.
title: Side Chair
